summary: An individual investor supports the proposal, including recognizing distributed ledgers as a method for maintaining the master securityholder file and digital wallet addresses as registration points. The commenter asks that any third-party tokenized instrument tracking a U.S. security be mapped one-to-one to the official transfer-agent ledger, and describes unbacked synthetic instruments without transfer-agent verification as a systemic risk. The letter urges the Commission to finalize the rules without weakening ledger-integrity and transfer-agent-control provisions. This is the commenter's position, not an SEC or TitleChain Foundation conclusion.
